body:
What happens: since v0.24.0, about 18 user-facing features merged with no change to the user guide (`site/content/guide/`). The next cut (v0.25.0) regenerates the documentation site from the tagged tree, so these features ship undocumented.

Features without guide text (PR, where it belongs):
- #2149 "Do not touch" face/edge protection on 2D Offset and 3D Pocket (breaking) - operations/operations-2d.md, operations-3d.md
- #2134 Place a DXF profile on a setup's stock (Sketch entity, ImportDxf; breaking) - only 1 doc line today; set-up/setups.md, operations-2d.md
- #2092 A tool's library holder is a reference to the library entry (breaking) - set-up/tools.md
- #2764 Tool body and profile editor in its own window; #2096 side preview from the checked holder - set-up/tools.md
- #2681 Plasma torch row carries a cut-data recipe by material and thickness - operations/operations-plasma.md, set-up/tools.md
- #2688, #2687 Deburr: picked and excluded edges, minimum edge angle, hole filter; policy for edges out of the cone's reach - operations/operations-2d.md (or wherever Deburr is described)
- #1713 Finish 3D gap_link - operations/operations-3d.md
- #2563 A linked model is imported again when its source file changes - set-up/setups.md
- #2310 Generic LinuxCNC 3-axis mill post and machine - check-and-post/machines.md
- #2352 Post dialog shows the post script path - check-and-post/posting.md
- #2662 Shift snapping and typed values in the viewport bar; #2665 save and restore panel setups - getting-started/keyboard-and-mouse.md, workflows.md
- #2542 Open a model or project file given on the command line - automate/cli.md, getting-started/first-run.md
- #1798 Report door: prefilled GitHub issue and clipboard screenshot - reference/troubleshooting.md
- #2122 AI providers, keychain keys, offline-only mode - a short pointer only; the full page is #1949

Not user-facing (no guide text needed): #2717, #2747, #2741.

Rules: describe behaviour from each PR body and its tests (read the merged code, not memory). Use the guide's existing style and headings. No screenshots of other products. Clean-room: our own words only. Mark the three breaking changes clearly (what an older build does with a newer file). `zola build` in `site/` must pass.

Done means: each feature above has guide text in the right page (or a reasoned "not needed" in the PR body), `zola build` passes, docs-only PR opened with `Changelog: none`.
